naslov: Tonye Jekiri and Luca Vildoza are game-time decisions for Partizan
tekst:
By Johnny Askounis/ info@eurohoops.net
Euroleague Basketball released the injury report for Round 11 of the 2026–27 EuroLeague Regular Season on Tuesday.
Keep tabs on the official league portal for further updates.
Wednesday, November 11
Partizan Mozzart Bet Belgrade vs. Kosner Baskonia Vitoria-Gasteiz (20:45 CET)
Partizan
Kevarrius Hayes and Derek Willis will miss the game, while Tonye Jekiri and Luca Vildoza will be game-day decisions, Partizan has confirmed.
- Tonye Jekiri is out for at least two weeks with a groin strain, the club announced on October 18. He last played in Round 6 but has started practicing with the team.
- Luca Vildoza left the Round 10 game in the first quarter with a forearm injury. He did not play in the ABA League game over the weekend.
- Derek Willis has been sidelined with an ankle injury he suffered in Round 1.
- Kevarius Hayes is out with a shoulder injury.
Baskonia
Baskonia has not yet sent an injury report.
- Tadas Sedekerskis last played in Round 7.
- Rodions Kurucs last played in Round 7.
Paris Basketball vs. Fenerbahce Istanbul (20:45 CET)
Paris
Paris has not yet sent an injury report.
- Daulton Hommes missed Rounds 9 and 10, but returned to action in the French League game this past weekend.
Fenerbahce
Fenerbahce has not yet sent an injury report.
- Coach Saras Jasikevicius had his full roster available in Round 10.
- New signing Dwight Powell has made his debut in Round 10.
- Onuralp Bitim is yet to play in the EuroLeague so far this season, but he has been featuring in the Turkish League.
Thursday, November 12
Maccabi Rapyd Tel Aviv vs. Hapoel IBI Tel Aviv (20:05 CET)
Maccabi
Maccabi has not yet sent an injury report.
- Iffe Lundberg will be out until December with a partial tear of his quadriceps.
Hapoel
Hapoel has not yet sent an injury report.
- Tomas Satoransky suffered a head injury after a hard fall in Round 9 and has not played since.
Olympiacos Piraeus vs. Dubai Basketball (20:15 CET)
Olympiacos
Olympiacos has not yet sent an injury report.
- New signing John Konchar made his debut in Round 10.
- Tyler Dorsey last played in Round 5 after being suspended by the club.
- Jean Montero last played in Round 6. He is ruled out for six months after knee surgery, the club announced on October 30.
Dubai
Dubai has not yet sent an injury report.
- Thomas Walkup has last played in Round 6.
- Justin Anderson made his season debut in the domestic league on Monday after missing the start of the season due to injury.
Valencia Basket vs. FC Bayern Munich (20:30 CET)
Valencia
Valencia has not yet sent an injury report.
- Nate Reuvers (foot) has last played in Round 7.
- Nikola Mirotic has last played in Round 8.
Bayern
Bayern has not yet sent an injury report.
- Coach Anton Gavel had his full roster available in Round 10.
Armani Olimpia Milan vs. Zalgiris Kaunas (20:30 CET)
Milan
Milan has not yet sent an injury report.
- Devin Booker suffered a torn tendon in his right thigh in Round 9 and will undergo further evaluation in the coming days.
Zalgiris
Zalgiris has not yet sent an injury report.
- Nigel Williams-Goss last played in Round 6. He is dealing with a hamstring injury.
Real Madrid vs. Crvena Zvezda Meridianbet Belgrade (21:00 CET)
Real Madrid
Real Madrid has not yet sent an injury report.
- Theo Maledon sprained his knee in Round 9 and has been out.
- Mikael Jantunen ruptured his plantar fascia in Round 9 and has been out.
- Facundo Campazzo is dealing with a hamstring injury and has not played in Round 10.
- Gaby Deck (shoulder) last played in Round 3, with coach Pedro Martinez saying ahead of Round 4: “The injury is more serious than we thought.”
- Usman Garuba suffered an Achilles injury at last May’s Final Four.
Crvena Zvezda
Crvena Zvezda has not yet sent an injury report.
- Stefan Miljenovic had an ankle surgery before Round 11 and is the only injured player on Coach Ibon Navarro’s roster.
Friday, November 13
Anadolu Efes Istanbul vs. Virtus Bologna (18:30 CET)
Efes
Efes has not yet sent an injury report.
- PJ Dozier has been out since Round 7 with a back injury.
- Mike James suffered an Achilles injury in Round 3 that will see him sidelined for 7-9 months.
- Isaia Cordinier remains sidelined after undergoing surgery in May, as was announced on May 18.
Virtus
Virtus has not yet sent an injury report.
- Tommaso Baldasso has last played in Round 7.
Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens vs. FC Barcelona (20:15 CET)
Panathinaikos
Panathinaikos has not yet sent an injury report.
- Nikos Rogkavopoulos last played in Round 5. He has been out ever since due to injury.
Barcelona
Barcelona has not yet sent an injury report.
- Kevin Punter has suffered a sprain to his left ankle and is expected to miss around 6 weeks.
- Tosan Evbuomwan has a tear in the oblique muscle of his abdominal wall and the recovery time is around 3 weeks.
- Umoja Gibson has last played in Round 8.
- Juan Nunez has last played in Round 8.
- Yoan Makoundou has not played so far this season as he recovers from a knee injury.
LDLC ASVEL Villeurbanne vs. Besiktas Istanbul (20:30 CET)
ASVEL
ASVEL has not yet sent an injury report.
- Myles Cale last played in Round 7.
- Juhann Begarin, who joined ASVEL on a short-term deal on October 7, has not yet played for the team in the EuroLeague.
- Mathis Dossou-Yovo (groin) has been sidelined to start this season.
Besiktas
Besiktas has not yet sent an injury report.
- Furkan Korkmaz has not appeared in a game since Round 6, but he did play in the Turkish League the past two weekends.
- Devon Dotson returned to action in Round 10 after a two-game absence.
- DaQuan Jeffries suffered a wrist injury in Round 1 and had to undergo surgery. He has been out ever since.
